title: Review S1/S2/S3 of PR #701: copied option citations, internal-splice provenance, Foresight thaw-note page
description:
Sol review eshyra-o9bd.16.7.4 of PR #701 @ a45a2b70 found two material findings and one non-material one. Full evidence is in the 16.7.4 notes.
S1: feature:draconic-bloodline:dragon-ancestor /choices/0/options/1..9/source cite 'SRD 5.1 p. 44', but those rows print on p.45; only Black is on p.44. deriveFeatureChoices.ts:1813 copies table.source before the final locator enrichment (index.ts:3650). The Circle Spells copy site (:1754) is a control and is correct at p.22.
S2: stripEmbeddedTableProse (emit.ts:2054, stripEmbeddedTableProse.ts:87-99) removes an INTERNAL table span and reflows the seam. The result is an adjacency that is not printed, yet the field still classifies as source-prose. Witnesses: feature:draconic-bloodline:dragon-ancestor /description (pp.44-45) and feature:sorcerer:font-of-magic /description (p.43). A trailing-table removal that leaves a contiguous prefix stays source-prose.
S3: thaw note 2026-11-01-eshyra-o9bd-16-7-1-source-true-projections.md:42 cites p.155 for Foresight; it should be p.147.
design:
S1: give each copied option source a truthful field-local citation. Use the row's own printed page when the row/table model carries it; otherwise use the final table span. Never invent pages. Apply this at both copy sites, and make Black (p.44) and Circle Spells (p.22) controls.
S2: make the producer report what it did. stripEmbeddedTableProse returns, per field, whether the removed span had non-whitespace source text AFTER it, i.e. an internal splice. The compiler derives record-scoped source-derived field-provenance declarations for exactly those (record, pointer) pairs and unions them with the hand declarations. A trailing removal stays source-prose. Do not hand-list witnesses. Check whether the classProgression trimEmbeddedTable path (Destroy Undead / Wild Shape) can use the same mechanism; if not, leave its hand declarations.
Regenerate with --out to the canonical path and run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack.
Evidence: (1) a generalized test that copied option citations equal their row's printed page or the enclosing table span, with the nine p.45 rows plus the Black and Circle Spells controls; (2) a producer/classification test for internal splices with both witnesses plus a contiguous tail-trimmed control; (3) a real context-packet check that neither witness renders under the verbatim heading. Follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md and add a thaw note. Do not weaken any test.
acceptance_criteria: S1-S3 repaired; pack regenerated and reproducible; verify:worktree passes; evidence as designed; commit on the child branch.
notes: COMPLETE: S1 option sources re-cited (Black p.44, nine rows p.45; Circle Spells p.22 control). S2 producer-reported internal splices -> scoped source-derived declarations for 17 /description fields (2 witnesses + 6 spells + 9 magic items; details in thaw note). S3 fixed. Two test helpers adjusted to target unscoped declarations. verify:worktree PASS, verify:dnd5e-srd-pack matches.
